name: Hollywood Street Greasers
description: The Howard Street Greasers (HSG) were a greaser street gang based in the Rogers Park neighborhood of Chicago, Illinois. Active from at least the late 1960s through the 1970s, they were known rivals of the Latin Kings and claimed territory along the west side of Howard Street's elevated train tracks. Members congregated at a local hangout called 'the Big Pit' near Touhy Park.
